title: Constraints
hints: With [T any], the compiler only allows operations that work for every possible type, and + doesn't work on, say, a struct. The constraint has to list the types that support +.
An interface can be a type set: interface{ int | float64 }. The tests also pass a Cents value, whose underlying type is int; ~int means "any type whose underlying type is int".
type Number interface { ~int | ~int64 | ~float64 } and func Sum[T Number](xs []T) T
